WelcomeStep.selectAPresetToQuicklyConfigure: Select a preset to quickly configure the essential flight modes for your style, or set up modes manually for full control.
WelcomeStep.presetItEnablesAngleModeWhich: preset. It enables ANGLE mode which keeps your aircraft level automatically - perfect for learning!

mode_presets.yourAircraftWillAlwaysStayLevel: Your aircraft will always stay level. Perfect for learning to hover and basic movements!
mode_presets.threePositionSwitchOnAux2Gives: Three-position switch on AUX2 gives you ANGLE/HORIZON/ACRO. Flip a switch to change your flying style!
mode_presets.pureAcroModeForMaximumControl: Pure ACRO mode for maximum control. Beeper on AUX3 helps find your aircraft after a crash!
mode_presets.navRthBringsYourAircraftHome: NAV RTH brings your aircraft home if signal is lost (requires GPS!). Perfect for long-range filming.
mode_presets.completeSetupForFixedWingWith: Complete setup for fixed-wing with launch assist, RTH, and waypoint navigation.
mode_presets.safetySwitchArmsDisarmsYourAircraft: SAFETY SWITCH - Arms/disarms your aircraft. ALWAYS put this on a dedicated switch! When armed, propellers can spin at any moment.
mode_presets.beginnerModeYourAircraftWillAutomaticall: BEGINNER MODE - Your aircraft will automatically level itself when you release the sticks. Maximum tilt angle is limited. Perfect for learning to fly!
mode_presets.intermediateModeSelfLevelsNearCenter: INTERMEDIATE MODE - Self-levels near center stick like ANGLE, but allows flips and rolls at full stick. A bridge between ANGLE and ACRO.
mode_presets.advancedKeepsFullStickAuthorityEven: ADVANCED - Keeps full stick authority even at zero throttle. Essential for freestyle tricks and flips. Usually kept on all the time.
mode_presets.holdsCurrentAltitudeUsingBarometerGps: Holds current altitude using barometer/GPS. Throttle controls climb/descent rate.
mode_presets.returnToHomeAircraftWillClimb: Return To Home - Aircraft will climb to safe altitude and fly back to launch point. Essential safety feature!
mode_presets.gpsPositionHoldAircraftWillStay: GPS position hold - Aircraft will stay in place. Great for aerial photography or when you need to stop.
mode_presets.executeUploadedWaypointMissionAircraftWi: Execute uploaded waypoint mission. Aircraft will fly to each waypoint automatically.
mode_presets.maintainsCurrentHeadingWhileAllowingAlti: Maintains current heading while allowing altitude control. Good for flying in a straight line.
mode_presets.fixedWingCruiseModeMaintainsHeading: Fixed-wing cruise mode - Maintains heading and altitude. Perfect for long-range flights.
mode_presets.automaticLaunchSequenceForFixedWing: Automatic launch sequence for fixed-wing. Throw the plane and it will climb to safe altitude.
mode_presets.allowGroundControlStationToSend: Allow ground control station to send navigation commands (fly-to-here, etc).
mode_presets.finderMakesYourAircraftBeepLoudly: FINDER - Makes your aircraft beep loudly to help you find it after a crash. Very useful when it lands in tall grass!
mode_presets.emergencyTriggersFailsafeBehaviorUsually: EMERGENCY - Triggers failsafe behavior (usually landing or disarm). Normally activated automatically when signal is lost.
mode_presets.loggingRecordsFlightDataToThe: LOGGING - Records flight data to the SD card for analysis. Useful for tuning PIDs and reviewing crashes.
mode_presets.keepsGimbalTiltAxisLevelRegardless: Keeps gimbal tilt axis level regardless of aircraft attitude. Useful for camera stabilization.
mode_presets.directServoMotorControlWithoutStabilizat: Direct servo/motor control without stabilization. For experienced pilots only!
mode_presets.activatesFlaperonsForSlowerLandingApproa: Activates flaperons for slower landing approach. Ailerons droop down to act as flaps.
mode_presets.autoCoordinatesRudderWithAileronsFor: Auto-coordinates rudder with ailerons for smooth turns. Great for fixed-wing beginners.
mode_presets.setsCurrentPositionAsNewHome: Sets current position as new home point. Use when you relocate during a session.
mode_presets.enableInFlightWaypointPlanningVia: Enable in-flight waypoint planning via stick commands.
mode_presets.maintainsCurrentMagneticHeadingUsefulFor: Maintains current magnetic heading. Useful for flying straight lines.
mode_presets.safetySwitchMustBeEnabledBefore: Safety switch - must be enabled before arming. Prevents accidental arm.
mode_presets.flipCrashedAircraftBackOverUsing: Flip crashed aircraft back over using motor spin. For multirotors only.
